statement_index_basis: Zero-based source pvsra.body, including source docstring at index 0. Retained statement ASTs are unchanged; only auction/session_tz keyword-only parameters and docstring differ.
default_branch_evidence: auction defaults to False; resolve_slots returns None immediately for False/None. Setup produces amask=None, takes slots=None branch; slots-is-not-None augmentation is skipped. Removed setup/branches occupy indices 8,9,10,11,22.

source_semantics.baseline: Previous lookback bars via shift(1), default 10; inclusive >= spread-volume climax; volume climax >=2.0, rising >=1.5 only when not climax.
source_semantics.timeframes: 5m red/green two-bar; 15m red/violet/green/blue one-bar. Adjacent pattern bars required.
source_semantics.level_ties: Newest confirmed_at, nearest confirming close, then source timeframe priority; stable source level iteration breaks exact ties.
